dog.description_text: Meet T'Challa — New Arrival! T'Challa just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. He is currently with one of our wonderful fosters. Copy and paste the link below in your browser for more information. https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/GRP_NYC_Foster/IQBYUIWAap0BSpn7u-ISMs9gAeAo2Yha-rjv0GDav7uSb-w?e=HYfEc4 T'Challa is timid at first and will best thrive in a supportive environment . He is very loving and gentle and likes to be pet. His foster says "Although he is often hiding, T’Challa is a very sweet boy and who loves pets. He just needs a home that is patient is with him and gives him time to feel safe. T’Challa loves to purr! Especially when getting pet!". T'Challa is a 7 year old male. He has been neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
